LAMBDA set {A B C S}
LAMBDA out S->A ; S->AB ; S->ABC ; S->AC ; S->B ; S->BC ; S->C ; A->a ; A->aA ; B->b ; B->bB ; C->c ;
UNIT out S->bb ; A->a ; B->c ; A->c ; B->a ; S->a ; S->c ; C->a ; C->c ;
UNIT2 out S->PQ ; S->a ; A->b ; Z->z ; P->p ; P->b ; Q->p ; Q->b ; A->p ; Z->p ; Z->b ; M->p ; M->b ; M->z ;
LAMBDA2 set {M P Z}
LAMBDA2 out S->PQ ; S->PQZ ; S->Q ; S->QZ ; Q->Q ; Q->QP ; Q->q ; Z->M ; Z->Z ; Z->ZM ; M->m ;
USELESS out S->a ;
CNF pre S->B(a)D(1) ; D(1)->SB(b) ; S->B(a)B(b) ; B(a)->a ; B(b)->b ;
CNF out S->AC ; C->SB ; S->AB ; A->a ; B->b ;
CNF pre S->AD(2) ; D(2)->SB(b) ; S->AB(b) ; S->AD(1) ; D(1)->SD(3) ; D(3)->BB(c) ; B(c)->c ; A->a ; B->B(b)B(b) ; B(b)->b ;
CNF out S->AF ; F->SC ; S->AC ; S->AE ; E->SG ; G->BD ; D->c ; A->a ; B->CC ; C->b ;
FIRST E {( a} FOLLOW {$ )}
FIRST X {! +} FOLLOW {$ )}
FIRST T {( a} FOLLOW {$ ) +}
FIRST Y {! *} FOLLOW {$ ) +}
FIRST F {( a} FOLLOW {$ ) * +}
LL E ( {TX}
LL E a {TX}
LL X ) {!}
LL X + {+TX}
LL X $ {!}
LL T ( {FY}
LL T a {FY}
LL Y ) {!}
LL Y * {*FY}
LL Y + {!}
LL Y $ {!}
LL F ( {(E)}
LL F a {a}
LL1 true
LL1 left-recursive false
SLR states 12
SLR 0: (=s1 a=s5 E=2 F=3 T=4
SLR 1: (=s1 a=s5 E=6 F=3 T=4
SLR 2: +=s7 $=acc
SLR 3: )=r4 *=r4 +=r4 $=r4
SLR 4: )=r2 *=s8 +=r2 $=r2
SLR 5: )=r6 *=r6 +=r6 $=r6
SLR 6: )=s9 +=s7
SLR 7: (=s1 a=s5 F=3 T=10
SLR 8: (=s1 a=s5 F=11
SLR 9: )=r5 *=r5 +=r5 $=r5
SLR 10: )=r1 *=s8 +=r1 $=r1
SLR 11: )=r3 *=r3 +=r3 $=r3
BRUTE 'aabb' -> true | aabb <- S-> ; | aaSbb <- S->aSb ; | aSb <- S->aSb ; | S <- 
BRUTE 'aab' -> false
BRUTE '' -> true |  <- S-> ; | S <- 
CYK baaba true
CYK aaa true
CYK b false
